title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.12593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. translated_title: 知你所不知：通过演化生成空间实现闭环学习的智能体数据合成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的持续改进日益依赖于合成经验，然而，面向交互式智能体的有效数据合成不仅需要可执行、可验证的轨迹，还需要能为当前任务智能体提供学习价值的交互。现有方法越来越多地引入环境反馈、数据验证或学习者失败信息，但仍面临“从反馈到决策”的鸿沟：观察到的弱点并不能直接指明未来的合成应如何改变，也无法确定这些弱点能否被当前的合成空间所表示。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了 EvoSyn，一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体框架，它围绕一个可修订的状态来组织合成，该状态规定了哪些交互因素可以被刻意生成，以及合成精力应分配到哪里。一个角色专门化的多智能体系统将学习者的反馈转化为合成修订，同时一个设计者负责分配合成……
tldr: EvoSyn 提出一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体数据合成框架，通过可修订的生成空间状态将智能体的学习弱点直接转化为合成修订与资源分配，弥合了反馈与决策之间的鸿沟，从而实现闭环学习。
en_tdlr: EvoSyn is a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that bridges the feedback-to-decision gap by translating learner weaknesses into synthesis revisions within an evolving, revisable generation space, enabling closed-loop agentic data synthesis for interactive agents.
